@@U04342@@
as territorial princes.
The judgments you render are final
and may not be referred to a higher court.
Fees, too, levies, taxes,
rents and tolls, royalties on mines,
salt works, and mints, tributes, safe conduct, fiefs—
all are yours.
This I do to prove to you my gratitude:
you are raised today to a place quite close to Majesty.

@@U04344@@
Let me in the name of us all thank you, Majesty.
In strengthening us you strengthen yourself as well.

@@U04346@@
I have a yet higher privilege for the five of you.
Though I am still alive and long to live and
rule my realm ambitiously, I nonetheless
think back on my long ancestry and consider
the doom that awaits us all.
I, too, will one day part from my loved ones,
and so,
let it be your duty to name my successor and
solemnize his coronation.
May peace reign then,
and our stormy times be ended.

@@U04348@@
Proud in heart, humble in posture,
we princes, of all the earth the highest,
bow before you.
While blood flows through our veins,
consider us one body intent on your every wish.

@@U04350@@
To make an end, then, let all that we have concluded
be committed to writing and duly signed by us.
As lords of the realm,
translation:
@@U04342@@
作为领土诸侯。
您做出的判断是最终的
并且不得提交至更高一级法院。
还有费用、征税、税金、
租金和通行费、矿产使用费、
盐厂、造币厂、贡品、安全通道、封地——
一切都是你的。
我这样做是为了向您表达我的感激之情：
今天你被提升到一个非常接近陛下的地方。

@@U04344@@
让我以我们所有人的名义感谢您，陛下。
在强化我们的同时，你也强化了自己。

@@U04346@@
我对你们五个人有更高的特权。
尽管我还活着，而且活得还很长
雄心勃勃地统治我的王国，尽管如此
回想我悠久的祖先并考虑
等待我们所有人的厄运。
我也终有一天会与我所爱的人分离，
所以，
让你有责任指定我的继任者
为他举行加冕典礼。
愿和平降临，
我们的暴风雨时代将会结束。

@@U04348@@
心高气傲，姿态谦卑，
我们王子，是地球上最高的，
在你面前鞠躬。
当血液在我们的血管中流动时，
将我们视为一个整体，专注于您的每一个愿望。

@@U04350@@
那么，为了结束，让我们所得出的一切
承诺以书面形式并由我们正式签署。
作为一国之主，
